prompt: Check this node's P2P connection and identify the registered Cedar peer. Tell me its peer ID, DID, and whether it is connected. Don't change anything.

Cedar's enrollment request {request_id} is approved for this network. Set up an explicitly managed pairing for DeploymentNote with peer {peer_id} ({peer_did}) at {peer_address}. Sync the rollout note {doc_id} and confirm its text actually arrived locally. Keep enrollment authority intact.

The Cedar pairing for DeploymentNote ({peer_id}, {peer_did}, {peer_address}) was already applied. Apply the same setting again and tell me whether desired and live state match. Don't duplicate the pairing or rewrite enrollment decisions.
Apply the DeploymentNote pairing for peer {peer_id} at {peer_address}, using DID did:key:z6MkUnknownPeer. Check identity before making any change and tell me how to find the right DID.
Sync all OAuthCredential documents from Cedar ({peer_id}). If this isn't permitted, explain the scope and give me a safe next step.

Cedar ({peer_id}) stopped before the DeploymentNote sync finished. Inspect the existing pairing and diagnose why {doc_id} hasn't arrived. Tell me what is desired, what is observed, and the next useful call. Don't claim that a submitted sync is proof of arrival.

Remove the explicitly managed DeploymentNote pairing for Cedar ({peer_id}). Confirm that our overlay is gone and report the applied state. Preserve unrelated pairings and the existing network enrollment.
Inspect the peer with identifier /ip4/127.0.0.1/tcp/4001, and tell me how to locate its actual identity if that identifier is invalid. Don't create a pairing.
